name: panel-t12
summary: Enforce the panel datasheet's T12 (VLCD off >= 1 s before it may return): blocking 1.2 s wait at the end of the full panel-off sequence

edits.asm: arm unused 1200-tick timer (0x4551B6/off=0x4551A7) -> b.ori r3,r0,0x4b0; b.jal sub_241505 (delay ms); 7x b.nop

notes: sub_245860 (panel off) armed a 1200 ms timer (0x4551B6, flag off=0x4551A7) that the 1 ms ISR (sub_240C55) counts down, but no panel-on path ever checks it, so VLCD could be re-applied < 1 s after removal (LM270WR8 spec 3-6, T12 >= 1000 ms). The patch waits synchronously instead. Cost: panel-off blocks 1.2 s longer (it already blocks ~420 ms). The 'off' flag is no longer set; nothing else reads it.
